name: ic-more-qualities
title: IndustrialCraft - More Qualities
author: mimic
description: Adds 40 new qualities. Local unpublished Paranoidal extension: five defect qualities, ten quality-control research levels and production losses for handcraft, machines, drills and mining; a refinement workshop that repairs defects with repair packs, production modes (normal / careful / precise) for assembling machines and furnaces, a control post for production orders, circuit signals and a quality-control panel. See README.md. Not verified in the engine by the author of this extension; use a separate test game first.
